author: Codex root personally owns the original-problem review and route/investment decision
scope: Review from the original remote-page-walk thesis through the multi-DMA measurement work and later mechanisms. This is a route audit, not automatic resumption of paused design/model/RTL work.

verdict.original_direction: Reasonable: extending a DMA's own remote miss penalty to external interference imposed on another DMA is a coherent research question. It was a hypothesis, never a guarantee of a novel algorithm.
verdict.early_work: Benchmark correctness, per-device/real-window measurement, hardware supply and controlled E3 were necessary. The original E4 finding of no overlap makes that necessity concrete.
verdict.later_drift: The paper's target did not stabilize while mechanisms, workloads and contracts expanded. Shared-source multicast, permission lifetimes and selectable destination pools are separate hypotheses whose need is not supplied by the original distinct-buffer, fixed-destination DMA experiment.
verdict.current_candidates: Keep L-M/L-W and shared-payload proposals archived/paused as unestablished hypotheses; current evidence does not justify further RTL investment in them.
verdict.continue: Retain the platform and original shared-IOMMU interference problem. Recommend one finite paper-feasibility/convergence pass, not unbounded innovation search. Continuing is justified only by a testable remaining contribution, not sunk engineering cost.
verdict.paper_level: No present basis to promise acceptance or a journal quartile. A useful independently supported mechanism, interface/implementation tradeoff, or novel predictive causal result can be a contribution; unprecedented mathematical primitives are not required.

chronological_assessment.question: Accelerator-side IOMMU remote page-walk cost
chronological_assessment.result: An FPGA evaluation environment, latency injection, working-set sweep, and pinned versus bounce+CPU-copy comparison are documented.
chronological_assessment.assessment: Useful platform/evaluation foundation; not automatically a new architectural mechanism, real multi-chiplet implementation or general security validation.

chronological_assessment.question: Can another DMA's translation activity damage V's state or progress?
chronological_assessment.result: Explicit E0–E4 causal questions and an early warning to select one claim that changes design choices. Inherited benchmark lacked independent V time and had correctness/measurement weaknesses.
chronological_assessment.assessment: A defensible extension; failure to freeze a publishable claim was already a risk, not a discovery made only after PN.

chronological_assessment.question: Is the observed slowdown actual simultaneous hardware contention?
chronological_assessment.result: E4 H about56ms, software totals about590/1014/1050ms, overlap0. Autonomous supply then produced about99.7% overlap; V hardware times56.56/107.10/154.99ms for Solo/A1/A8.
chronological_assessment.assessment: Necessary scientific correction. Early software slowdown cannot be reused as proof of IOMMU HOL. Later overlap establishes meaningful experimental pressure.

chronological_assessment.phase: DS sensitivity and controlled E3, September16–18; E2 later
chronological_assessment.question: Does delayed A translation propagate to an already waiting V hit, and can cache damage persist after A stops?
chronological_assessment.result: DS sensitivity observed; E3 four complementary pairs have A and V remaining-delay increments127/129/129/130 cycles. E2 later records W7 retention versus W8 replacement and first misses.
chronological_assessment.assessment: Supported local mechanism facts. They do not alone identify every end-to-end slowdown or establish novel nonblocking/capacity protection.

chronological_assessment.question: Protect V while preserving A's useful progress
chronological_assessment.result: A meaningful V/A tradeoff was measured; fixed-A8 method88 p5 trails the best protection-matched simple control in all four boot/direction cells by4.44–8.24%.
chronological_assessment.assessment: A legitimate scoped negative result. It ends that tested main claim, not all dynamic feedback scheduling or the entire research direction. Best-per-cell is not automatically one online baseline.

chronological_assessment.phase: S/P/N/PN, bug fixes and history isolation, October4–7
chronological_assessment.question: Do capacity protection and hit bypass translate into joint progress?
chronological_assessment.result: Functional172, isolated22 and board short18 belong to distinct scopes. History isolation removes the miss-count difference; PN slowdown remains in tested cases. A DDR model demonstrates legal translation/data queue coupling, without fully attributing the board difference.
chronological_assessment.assessment: Useful diagnostic/control infrastructure. PN must not be required to win by intuition, and a fix or a percentage improvement is not by itself novelty.

chronological_assessment.question: Repeatedly redefined resource, information and contract
chronological_assessment.result: Many hand/model/RTL candidates were covered by concrete controls. In-flight joining has29 actual complete-copy passes, but ordinary startup sharing is faster in the tested permission-ready case. L-M/L-W positive samples have explicit reproducing controls.
chronological_assessment.assessment: The main drift: broadening the object and rebuilding examples faster than a stable application/architecture need and paper claim were established. Correct negative results are retained, but increasingly elaborate contracts need their own motivation.

process_corrections: Freeze problem, scope, claimed new capability and primary success criterion before selecting a mechanism.
Distinguish published coverage, a simple control reproducing a local sample, and a full candidate being uncompetitive. Do not collapse them into one novelty verdict.
A control supplied with the proposal's entire new information/action may be an equivalent implementation or an ablation, not prior-art evidence.
Freeze concrete independent policies and their tuning protocol. A best-per-case envelope is an offline bound, not a free deployable online algorithm.
Allow a small model on a credible reachable difference hypothesis. Do not demand completed full-area proof or universal superiority before any model; require stronger evidence before FPGA investment.
Microbenchmarks with explicit motivated semantics and legal original traces can support architectural mechanisms. A deployed full application is not universally required before exploration.
Functional passes, repaired bugs, new probes, literature volume, agent count and stage numbers are not substitutes for an accepted paper contribution.
Root responsibility: earlier coordination let problem changes and growing audit work continue without a stable paper exit; more workers did not solve that selection problem.

finite_recommendation.status: Recommendation only; no experiments or new mechanism work started in this audit.
finite_recommendation.duration: Proposed management cap:1–2 weeks if the user resumes. This is a decision deadline, not a promise of a solution or automatic authorization to start.
finite_recommendation.fixed_question: Under an explicitly limited shared-IOMMU/DMA workload and architecture, which resource prevents critical DMA progress, and can an independently motivated small change improve V/A useful progress or a complete cost frontier?
deliverables: One-page proposed contribution and closest primary comparison, written before another hardware change. A research question is not yet a novelty claim.
Reuse existing records to define one decisive unresolved causal/predictive question and two or three fixed executable direct controls; no whole literature-map or172-case restart.
A minimal legal original-start scenario with an adjacent counterexample and held-out conditions. Compare useful V/A or real implementation cost, not only misses, occupancy or component counts.

A go/stop decision: if a credible independent gap survives, model it minimally; if no meaningful residual or novel prediction remains beyond known controls, stop this mechanism search and change the paper question with the supervisor. Existing platform remains reusable.
finite_recommendation.caveats: Do not resurrect p5 just because fixed-A8 is a limited negative, or claim characterization/negative results are already sufficient for publication. A methods-paper goal still needs a method contribution; a characterization-paper goal needs independently new actionable knowledge.

primary_checks.title: Beyond the Bermuda Triangle of Contention: IOMMU Interference in Mixed Criticality Systems
primary_checks.scope: Abstract/contribution statement and §V-C mitigation boundary: real DMA/IOMMU interference was characterized; full mitigation evaluation outside scope. Supports relevance and limits a broad first-interference claim, not exhaustive field coverage.

primary_checks.title: MASK: Redesigning the GPU Memory Hierarchy to Support Multi-Application Concurrency
primary_checks.scope: §5.4 handles translation/data memory interference and fairness. Basic table priority/joint resource control is old, but GPU design is not an exact drop-in DMA baseline.

primary_checks.title: Overcoming the IOTLB wall for multi-100-Gbps Linux-based networking
primary_checks.scope: Contributions and driver allocator/evaluation sections: existing hugepage technology is turned into a concrete allocator addressing driver/placement/cost constraints. Illustrates that integration contribution need not invent the underlying primitive; does not establish this project's novelty.

evidence_review_limits: Read the original thesis's goal/contribution/conclusion, early plans and benchmark review, selected E1/E4/E3/DS/late reports, original saved review JSON and critical decision cards. Did not rerun the old thesis data, every board log, any model or build. Findings are a bounded evidence-based route judgment, not a new performance result.

worker_acceptance.historical: DeepSeek full historical table is navigation, not sole proof. Root read key underlying records and original primary passages.
worker_acceptance.early: Accept early chronology. Reject interpreting old E0/HPM null flags or early E2-pending as today's status; later evidence already establishes scoped E2. Full global calibration status was not reassessed here.
worker_acceptance.standard_audit: Independent critical Codex review identifies round01 C's unfrozen dynamic-control gate and stage80 per-case-oracle risk; root inspected the cited original passages. Recent records often already correctly limit conclusions.
